about: ExtraKonpaku's own CharaStatus. Only these cells differ from the version's CharaStatus.fsv; the launcher writes them at launch (launcher/mode_status.py) and gamemode.dll applies the same cells in a room that picked this mode. "+x"/"-x" adds to the version's value, a bare number replaces it; row "*" is every character row, a character's own row wins for its columns.
